metadata.description: شجرة لمراكز ومعاهد التدريب المهني والتقني، مع التركيز على الورش والمعدات والمواد العملية والشهادات.
metadata.currency_policy: Organization-configured; never hardcode SAR or another currency.
design_notes: This blueprint is a starting institutional COA, not a replacement for the organization's statutory accounting policy.
Grades, classes, faculties, departments, campuses, branches and programs should be modeled as dimensions/cost centers/org units where supported, not by duplicating the account tree.
Bootstrap may install this blueprint as the initial protected/root structure; organization-specific child accounts remain configurable according to Orbis accounting rules.
Account IDs used at runtime must be resolved from the created organization's accounts; these source codes are stable blueprint codes, not database IDs.
